description: Defines data classes MediaItem, GenreRowData, and TabItem used for representing media data structures in the application.

classes.name: MediaItem
classes.description: Represents a media item with id, title, description, and genre.

classes.name: GenreRowData
classes.description: Holds a genre title and a list of media items belonging to that genre.

classes.name: TabItem
classes.description: Represents a tab with id and title for UI navigation.
